rule: D47 rule 5, as amended after the review (M2): the page's own search (matchPatient) for each of the five templates under stated findings, coded only and hedged findings, pooled over the declared seeds, with at least 30 candidates (patients with a window and a candidate for every step). Ruled: the share of the distinct child types (PLAN keys; C001 is reference) with a candidate that have a decided candidate (exact or possible) is at least main's on the same seeds less 5 percentage points. Reported: the owner's unresolved bar (it cannot fail for the page's own search, whose only unresolved is an exhausted search budget), all candidates and the count without C001, and the share of child types whose status moves to none or not comparable
